question: How should one desiring accomplishment by meditation and recitation act?
premises: One desiring accomplishment by meditation and recitation should do rite for purification.
By own will he does it.
inference: Such a person performs rite for purification by will, then more according to prior rule.
plain_english: One desiring accomplishment by meditation and recitation should do rite for purification by his own will, then more according to prior rule.
